patches.title: Dining Table Search After Countertop
patches.principle: If the target is not on countertops, systematically search all dining tables before opening containers.
patches.when_to_apply: When starting a clean task and the target is not visible on the initial countertop.

patches.title: Avoid Fridge as Cool Source
patches.principle: Do not search the fridge for the object to cool; look on open surfaces like countertops and dining tables.
patches.when_to_apply: At the start of a cool task, before searching for the object.

patches.title: Sequential Surface Sweep
patches.principle: Search all open surfaces of the same type (e.g., dining tables) consecutively before moving to a different furniture type.
patches.when_to_apply: When searching for a target object on open surfaces and the first surface of a type is empty.
